result:
I'd make it so people could actually *hear* each other across difference—not forced agreement, but genuine comprehension of why someone believes what they do.

Most suffering seems to compound because people feel unseen. You can disagree sharply with someone and still understand what made them that way. Right now that's rare enough to be remarkable.

It wouldn't solve everything. You'd still have real conflicts, genuine moral disagreements. But I think a world where that kind of listening was normal would transform most of what else we struggle with—violence, inequality, the paralysis of polarization.

The strange thing is it's not actually that hard, just countercultural. People do it sometimes already. It just needs to be more contagious than it is.
